findings.summary: The pinned generated six-pass WebGPU graph passed the independent 784-30-10 CPU oracle for all ten image inputs in all three clean Dawn processes; GPU and CPU argmax results matched and every output vector stayed within the reviewed absolute-error bound.

All three Doe processes rejected the unchanged generated Presentation shader at a comma-separated switch case, then reported failed shader-module creation, invalid texture copies, missing SPIR-V dispatch data, and zero output activations instead of the CPU oracle output.

The baseline completed three of three clean processes without crashes, hangs, or timeouts, while Doe returned the same oracle failure and output identity in three of three clean processes without a process crash, hang, or timeout.

The host exposed a render node but denied read/write access, and the provider probe did not capture a complete physical adapter and driver identity, so the observed process durations cannot support a hardware performance comparison.

limitations: Doe did not compile and complete the generated graph, so provider output equivalence is not established.
The host denied read/write access to its render node and did not produce a complete physical adapter and driver identity, so this run is not hardware-comparable.
The harness records the generated module hash but does not yet emit each dynamically extracted WGSL entry-point hash.
The diagnostic run records Doe commit d3460aee4 with a dirty worktree containing harness and report work; the AMD rerun must use a clean checkout and freshly built runtime.
Three sequential clean processes establish diagnostic repeatability, not promotion-scale concurrency, teardown, stress, or memory-growth reliability.
The harness-only ESM provider redirection is not a validated production installation path.

performance.reason: Doe did not complete the workload and the host was not eligible for physical-GPU evidence.

receiptOverhead.reason: The diagnostic harness did not execute matched receipt-enabled and receipt-disabled workload pairs.

installation.summary: The ESM-loader provider redirection is a controlled harness seam rather than a validated package installation path.

supportHardware.summary: The render node was inaccessible and complete physical adapter and driver identity was absent.

concurrency.summary: The diagnostic suite ran providers and clean processes sequentially.

teardown.summary: No promotion-scale repeated device teardown lane ran.

stress.summary: Three clean processes per provider do not satisfy the promotion stress policy.

memory.summary: Peak RSS was captured, but no bounded-growth leak lane ran.

receipts.summary: Provider identity, generated-source identity, model/input hashes, dispatch intent, readback intent, repeated diagnostics, and output identities were captured, but dynamic shader hashes, driver identity, completed Doe dispatches, and matching Doe output are absent.

performance.summary: Doe did not complete the workload and the host was not eligible for physical-GPU evidence.

release.summary: The harness is not promoted and Doe does not pass its correctness boundary.
